EDJ-ADV-2026#64: "Most financial advisors receive a portion of the Program Fee, though some financial advisors receive a salary in addition to, or in lieu of, the Program Fee... The portion of the Program Fee paid to your financial advisor is at the discretion of Edward Jones. The fee rate paid to your financial advisor will be the same regardless of the model in which you invest."
